en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a busy urban square with a decorative stone fountain or monument in a circular flowerbed in the foreground. Around it are pedestrians, bicycles and early/mid‑20th‑century buses. In the background stand multi‑storey buildings and, prominently, a large domed building. The reverse side has printed Hungarian text indicating it is a greeting from Pécs and standard postcard layout for address and stamp.
